subject: Helix AI pilot — bridge request: extra week vs. conversion discount
messages:
From: Priyanka Shah <priyanka@helix.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Martinez <ava@helix.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: extra week for pilot + ask on conversion discount

Hi Jordan,

We're running toward the end of our 30-day pilot and the engineering team hit two bigger data ingestion scenarios later than we expected. Usage this week spiked and we don't feel confident the experiments we've run are representative yet. Can we get a one-week extension (7 days) on the pilot?

Separately, leadership is asking whether Redwood can commit to a conversion discount if we sign a 12-month committed plan within 30 days of pilot close. Rough ask from their VP: if we convert, would Redwood consider a 15–20% discount on list for the first 6 months (applied to inference usage)?

Quick context: current pilot uses a dedicated small GPU pool, avg latency ~220ms, token burn ~1.8M tokens/day during peak tests. We've attached the usage export.

Appreciate a fast reply—our procurement deadline for internal signoff is Nov 24.

Thanks,
Priyanka
Priyanka Shah
Head of Platform Engineering, Helix AI
---
Attachments: Helix-pilot-usage-report.csv (CSV)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Shah <priyanka@helix.ai>
Cc: Ava Martinez <ava@helix.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: extra week for pilot + ask on conversion discount

Hi Priyanka—thanks for the usage export and the heads-up. We're glad the test ramp surfaced the ingestion cases. Short answers up front: yes to a short extension, and we can put a conditional discount on the table subject to a committed 12‑month license.

Proposed options (pick one):
- Option A — Operational extension: +7 days at no additional charge (we extend the pilot window and preserve current provisioning). No discount guaranteed; conversion at list.
- Option B — Conversion-conditional discount: 15% off inference usage for the first 6 months if Helix signs a 12‑month committed contract within 30 days of pilot close. To support this we would need a signed LOI or a purchase order commitment window and an internal exec sign-off from my side.
- Option C — Hybrid: +4 days extension today and 10% conversion discount for 6 months if a 12‑month commitment is signed within 30 days.

Operational notes: extending the pilot impacts reserved capacity planning slightly; we can keep the current small GPU pool available provided we get confirmation by EOD Wed Nov 11. If you want the full +7 days we will draft a short SOW amendment.

I cc'd Kimberly (legal) and David (CS) to confirm the amendment language and any SLA/ops credit clauses. I attached a slim proposal (proposal_v2.pdf) showing the three options and the conversion discount math.

Would you be available for a 20-minute sync today at 4pm PT to pick which path?

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Ph: 415-555-0183
---
Attachments: proposal_v2.pdf (PDF)

From: Priyanka Shah <priyanka@helix.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Martinez <ava@helix.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: extra week for pilot + ask on conversion discount

Jordan—thanks. We discussed options internally. Short response: we need the full +7 days to finish the ingestion tests (Option A), but leadership is pushing for 20% off for the first 6 months if we commit to 12 months. They view the price gap as material to the ROI case. If Redwood can't do 20%, would you accept 15% plus a $15k implementation credit (applied against the first invoice) to help cover our internal integration work?

If you can do the 15% + $15k credit we can likely get VP-level sign-off and get the LOI across the table within 10 business days of pilot close.

Also, a practical ask—can Redwood supply a one-paragraph statement confirming you will retain pilot telemetry for 90 days for post-mortem evaluation? We'll need that for our audit trail.

Thanks,
Priyanka

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Shah <priyanka@helix.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: extra week for pilot + ask on conversion discount

Hi Priyanka—apologies for the slight delay. Legal & commercial reviewed Jordan's options and your counter. We can agree to a conditional package as follows: 

- Pilot extension: +7 days at no additional charge; will deliver a 1-page SOW amendment to extend the pilot window and preserve current capacity.
- Commercial concession: 15% off inference usage for the first 6 months upon signature of a 12‑month committed plan within 30 days of pilot close, plus a one-time $10,000 implementation credit (applied to the first invoice).
- We cannot stretch to 20% discount, but the combination above is intended to bridge the ROI gap.
- Telemetry: Redwood confirms we will retain the pilot telemetry and logs for 90 days post-pilot for your evaluation; we will provide an export and a read-only Drive link.

If that package works, Jordan will send an LOI template and I will attach the SOW amendment and an editable SOW that includes the extension and the conditional discount language. We will also prepare a DocuSign link for the 12‑month purchase order when you're ready.

Next steps: Priyanka, please confirm acceptance by reply and Jordan will push the LOI + SOW amendment by EOD Tuesday Nov 18.

Best regards,
Kimberly Park
Director, Commercial & Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
